positions.title: Application Development Intern at Workday
positions.description: Worked with HR, Talent Management Development Team. Worked in close coordination with other developers, project managers, and QA team in an agile team environment.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern: Online & Middleware Application Operations
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
-Monitoring/Management of Oracle WebLogic Servers with Oracle Enterprise Manager 12c.
-Created custom reports with Oracle BI Publisher to provide the team with a centralized view of the health of web tier, application tier, and database tier targets and identify any problematic conditions not captured by OEM. With these reports, every morning, the engineers are presented with a list of downed or faulty components. This takes the guesswork out as the team knows exactly what requires their attention, resulting in increased team productivity as well as reliability of their service.
-Assisted in developing a web based tool for Middleware engineers at PG&E to monitor and service WebLogic Domains from a mobile platform. Specifically worked on integrating Oracle's WebLogic Scripting Tool (WLST) using the Python Interactive Interpreter for Java to embed its functionality into the web tool.

projects.title: Foodloggr at AngelHack Silicon Valley 2015
projects.description:
In 24 hours, we developed Foodloggr, a mobile application to streamline tracking nutritional intake. Simply snap a picture of any nutrition label with your phone and Foodloggr automatically reads the facts and analyzes them based on your height, weight, age, and fitness level to help you maintain a healthy diet.

Our application utilized HP's Haven OnDemand Optical Character Recognition (OCR) API to extract nutritional data from photos taken on the phone. 

Check out HP's article on our app, along with others that competed in HP's challenge at AngelHack:
https://community.idolondemand.com/t5/Blog/AngelHack-Silicon-Valley-The-Final-Hoorah-of-2015-AngelHack/ba-p/1940
